skill.name: jira-workflow
skill.description: Orchestrate Jira workflows with approved story creation, Jira REST API examples, lifecycle transitions, comments, and Claude Code task syncing.
skill.summary: Manage Jira stories, approvals, workflow transitions, and implementation updates from one guided workflow.

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives from Markdown formatting and JavaScript template literals. The real risks are expected Jira network access and Jira credential handling through environment variables, especially JIRA_API_TOKEN. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Jira API token is read from the environment and sent in Basic authentication headers.
remediation.suggestion: Document a scoped Jira API token, validate JIRA_BASE_URL, and warn users not to use administrator credentials.

remediation.issue: The examples perform authenticated Jira mutations such as issue creation, comments, and transitions.
remediation.suggestion: Keep explicit approval gates before every write operation and log the intended issue key and target state first.

remediation.issue: The documentation references executable scripts that are not present in the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove those references or include the scripts so users can inspect them before execution.

remediation.issue: Error and status logs may include Jira issue summaries or API response text.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid logging sensitive ticket content unless the user asks for detailed diagnostics.

content.user_title: Manage Jira Workflows with Approval Gates
content.value_statement: Teams lose time translating work requests into Jira stories and status updates. This skill guides approved story creation, workflow transitions, comments, and completion tracking.
actual_capabilities: Builds SAFe-style user story proposals with acceptance criteria and definition of done.
Requires user approval before creating Jira items.
Shows Jira REST API examples for creating stories and subtasks.
Queries available Jira transitions before moving issues between workflow states.
Adds work log and implementation detail comments to Jira issues.
Maps Jira progress to Claude Code TodoWrite task states.
limitations: Requires Jira Cloud credentials, project permissions, and configured environment variables.
Targets Jira REST API v3 and a team-managed workflow with specific status names.
Cannot know valid transition IDs until it queries the target Jira project.
The audited package contains documentation only; referenced script files are not present.

use_cases.title: Plan Approved Product Stories
use_cases.description: Convert a work request into a SAFe story proposal, then create it only after approval.

use_cases.title: Track Sprint Workflow State
use_cases.description: Move Jira issues from backlog to active work and done while adding implementation notes.

use_cases.title: Sync Coding Work with Jira
use_cases.description: Coordinate Claude Code task progress with Jira issue comments and status transitions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Story Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a SAFe story proposal for [request]. Include persona, goal, benefit, acceptance criteria, definition of done, and subtasks. Ask for approval before Jira creation.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Approved Story
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the approved Jira story for [proposal] in project [project key]. Use [epic key] if provided, and summarize the created issue key.

prompt_templates.title: Move a Jira Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Query available transitions for [issue key], choose the transition matching [target state], and explain the status change before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Run the Full Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: For [task], propose the story, wait for approval, create it under [epic key], start work, add implementation details, and transition it to Done.

output_examples.input: Plan a signup API story for Jira.
output: A proposed story with persona, goal, benefit, acceptance criteria, and definition of done.
A clear approval question before any Jira item is created.

output_examples.output: The skill queries available transitions, selects the matching Jira transition, and reports the new workflow state.
The skill adds a Jira comment with modified files, commits, notes, and then transitions the issue to Done.

best_practices: Query available transitions before every status change.
Ask for explicit approval before creating Jira issues or subtasks.
Use a scoped Jira API token with the minimum required project permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not transition issues without confirming the target state is available.
Do not use an administrator Jira token for routine workflow updates.
Do not run referenced scripts unless their contents are present and reviewed.

faq.question: Does this skill create Jira issues automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to ask for user approval before creating Jira issues.

faq.question: Which Jira version does it target?
faq.answer: It targets Jira Cloud REST API v3 and team-managed workflow states.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: It expects Jira email, Jira API token, base URL, project key, and optional board ID variables.

faq.question: Can it handle custom workflow states?
faq.answer: Yes. It queries available transitions before choosing a target state.

faq.question: Does the package include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The audited package includes SKILL.md only, although the documentation references scripts.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
